description: Find Steam games matching filters, e.g. every game tagged both 'Cozy' and 'Farming Sim', released since 2022, priced $10-25, with at least 100 reviews. Tags are Steam's user tags (case-insensitive); all given tags must match. Returns up to 50 games, sorted by review count unless asked otherwise, plus how many matched in total. Use estimate_sales on the results for sales estimates.

max_price_usd.description: Highest list price (before discounts) in US dollars.

max_reviews.description: Most Steam user reviews, e.g. to leave out breakout hits.

min_price_usd.description: Lowest list price (before discounts) in US dollars, e.g. 9.99. 0 includes free games.

min_reviews.description: Fewest Steam user reviews. Reviews track sales, so this filters out games that sold little.

sort.description: Most reviews first, newest or oldest release first, or cheapest first.

name: find_games
title: Find Steam games by tags, price and release date
